nodes.description: External caller address; validated by auth, onlyOwner, onlyPool, cdpAllowed, urnAllowed and onlyMember before privileged state changes.
block.timestamp (now) used for tic[cdp], spin() start times, chooseMember randomness, GRACE windows and OSM timing.
Address of the MakerDAO Vat; target of all flux/move/frob/fork calls.
Auto-incrementing CDP id counter incremented in open().
Mapping CDPId => owner address, used by cdpAllowed and rewritten by give().
Mapping CDPId => collateral type (ilk).
Urn => delegate => allowed mapping written by urnAllow().
Owner => CDPId => delegate => allowed mapping written by cdpAllow().
Only address permitted to call topup/bite/untopByPool on the liquidation machine.
Mapping CDPId => art units topped up by the pool; consumed by bite and drained by untop.

DSAuthority contract consulted by isAuthorized for delegated permissions.

Allowlisted liquidator addresses scanned by onlyMember.
Member => internal DAI (rad) balance used for deposits, withdrawals and winner selection.

EndLike contract used to read cat().ilks(ilk).chop inside calcDink.
PriceFeedLike oracle read by calcDink to convert tab into collateral.
Minimum art for a topup to be shared among all members instead of a single winner.
Mapping CDPId => CdpData (art, cushion, members, bite) tracking pool positions.
Creates a new CDP, deploys an UrnHandler and links it into the owner's list.

Grants or revokes delegation on a CDP, guarded by cdpAllowed.
Grants or revokes delegation on the caller's own urn.

onlyPool entry point that liquidates part of a CDP and seizes collateral.
Internal function removing the pool cushion from a CDP before the user acts.

Computes seized collateral from chop, rate and the real price feed.
Forwards position changes to the external score contract.
Untops, notifies the score and then frobs the CDP via super.
Untops, reports the position to the score and migrates the CDP via super.
onlyMember deposit of rad into the pool.
Withdraws rad from the pool back to the caller.
onlyMember entry that selects winners and tops up a CDP through the manager.
onlyMember entry that resets a CDP's pool bookkeeping.
onlyMember liquidation that calls man.bite and splits the seized ink.
Pseudo-random single-winner selection based on cdp and now.
auth-protected arbitrary call to any target with any calldata.
auth-protected replacement of the member allowlist.
auth-protected owner update.
Checks self, owner and authority for msg.sender and msg.sig.

Permissionless round advancement driven by now against end[0]/end[1].

edges.reason: cdpAllowed gates cdpAllow on msg.sender == owns[cdp] or on cdpCan[owns[cdp]][cdp][msg.sender] == 1.
urnAllow writes urnCan[msg.sender][usr], letting the caller delegate rights over its own urn.
onlyPool requires msg.sender == pool before topup may move vat funds.
onlyPool requires msg.sender == pool before bite can seize collateral.
onlyMember scans members[] against msg.sender before Pool.bite executes.
the auth modifier requires isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig) before emergencyExecute runs.
the auth modifier protects setOwner with isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig).
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() with _owner before transferOwnership.
onlyOwner restricts ScoringMachine.spin to the contract owner.
getNumMembers performs unbounded raw calls triggered by unprivileged callers.
onlyMember checks the msg.sender against members[] before deposit is credited.
tic[cdp] = now is written when a CDP becomes unsafe, so the GRACE window is timestamp dependent.
chooseMember derives its winner index from keccak256(cdp, now/1 hours), which the block producer can bias.
ScoringMachine.spin records start = now, so scores depend on the miner-controlled timestamp.
JarConnector.spin advances rounds from now against end[0] and end[1].
untop reverts while bitten(cdp) is true, i.e. while tic[cdp] + GRACE > now.
Pool.topup eligibility depends on block.timestamp versus the OSM zzz()/hop() schedule.
flux forwards collateral to VatLike(vat).flux.
move forwards internal DAI to VatLike(vat).move.
cdpAllowed reads owns[cdp] and its delegate table to authorize the caller.
give rewrites owns[cdp] and repairs the linked list pointers for both owners.
bite reads ilks[cdp] to select the collateral type for the seize.
urnAllow writes urnCan[msg.sender][usr], extending urn permissions.
cdpAllow writes cdpCan[owns[cdp]][cdp][usr] = ok.
bite pulls cushion debt from pool via vat.move(pool, address(this), dtab).
bite rewrites cushion[cdp] with usedCushion = mul(cushion,dart)/art and sub(), so truncation and silent-zero math can drift pool accounting.
untop returns the entire cushion[cdp] to the pool and zeroes it.
tic[cdp] is written inside bite only when the CDP is proven unsafe.
topup returns immediately while out[cdp] is true, skipping the position.
setOwner assigns owner after the auth check has passed.
isAuthorized delegates the final decision to authority.canCall(src, address(this), sig).
score.updateScore is an external call to an owner-configurable contract made while CDP state is being mutated.
left[cdp] == 0 gates whether the external score.updateScore call is made.
members[] is scanned by onlyMember before Pool.bite performs any state change.
withdraw debits rad[msg.sender] and then transfers via vat.move.
chooseMember skips candidates whose rad[] balance is below the required contribution.
Pool.bite calls man.bite on the external manager to perform the liquidation.
Pool.bite fluxes the jar share of dink to the jar address.
Pool.bite debits rad[msg.sender] by dart*rate minus the cushion portion before returning.
round drives the JarConnector.spin state machine and must reach 3 before scoring stops.
spin resets start to now, restarting the scoring baseline.
updateAssetScore mutates userScore[user][asset] using balance * elapsed arithmetic.
slashScore reads manager.urns/ilks/vat to size the penalty against a malicious CDP.
calcDink reads end.cat().ilks(ilk) to obtain the chop value.
calcDink divides by real.read(ilk) without validating the oracle response.
topup branches on art < minArt to decide between chooseMember and chooseMembers.
Pool.bite reads and updates cdpData[cdp].bite, members, cushion and art.
open deploys a fresh UrnHandler contract for every CDP id without any cap.
open increments cdpi = add(cdpi, 1) to allocate the new id.
open assigns owns[cdpi] = usr and ilks[cdpi] = ilk.
open runs the note modifier whose inline assembly log4 copies raw calldata.
DssCdpManager.frob calls VatLike(vat).frob on an external contract.
flux calls VatLike(vat).flux with a caller-supplied destination.
move calls VatLike(vat).move with a caller-supplied destination.
quit reads vat.urns and then invokes vat.fork to migrate the position.
enter calls vat.fork with a caller-supplied src urn gated only by urnAllowed.
shift calls vat.fork between two caller-supplied CDPs.
topup calls vat.move(pool, address(this), dtab) and vat.frob(..., -toInt(dtopup)) before updating cushion.
bite sizes the collateral to seize by calling calcDink.
bite performs the actual seize through doBite(bart, ilk, urn, dink).
bite reports -dink and -dart to the score contract with the current timestamp.
doBite calls vat.move and twice vat.frob, reentering the Vat before the caller finishes accounting.
untop calls vat.frob then vat.move to return the cushion to the pool.
updateScore forwards to the external score contract, an owner-configurable callback surface.
BCdpManager.frob untops the CDP before mutating the position.
BCdpManager.frob notifies the score contract before the super call.
BCdpManager.frob delegates to DssCdpManager.frob.
BCdpManager.quit untops the CDP before migrating it.
BCdpManager.quit reports the migrated ink/art to the score contract.
BCdpManager.quit delegates to DssCdpManager.quit.
Pool.topup selects winners with chooseMember when art < minArt.
Pool.topup calls man.topup on the external BCdpManager, which mints debt in the Vat.
Pool.bite calls man.bite, an external liquidation entry point, before finishing its own rad accounting.
Pool.bite performs two vat.flux calls after the external manager call returns.
chooseMember derives the winner index from keccak256(cdp, now/1 hours) modulo the candidate count.
emergencyExecute forwards arbitrary calldata to an arbitrary target with no selector restriction.
setMembers replaces the allowlist used by the onlyMember modifier.
setOwner overwrites the owner state variable and emits LogSetOwner.
isAuthorized queries authority.canCall when the caller is neither self nor owner.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner through _transferOwnership.
slashScore applies the penalty through the internal updateScore path using a backdated time.
BCdpScore.updateScore writes userScore for the derived user and asset keys.
JarConnector.spin calls score.spin() on the external BCdpScore contract.
spin increments round and records the corresponding start[] timestamp.
getNumMembers loops raw calls to pool.members(uint256) until a call reverts.
cdp selects the owns/cdpCan entry validated by the cdpAllowed modifier.
cdp indexes urns, ilks, cushion and tic inside LiquidationMachine.bite.
cdp indexes cdpData and is forwarded to man.bite from Pool.bite.
dtopup is converted into dtab = mul(rate, dtopup) and minted as new urn debt.
dart determines how much debt is wiped and drives calcDink/doBite.
dart is capped by availBite and forwarded to man.bite from Pool.bite.
deposit moves radVal into the pool and credits rad[msg.sender].
withdraw debits rad[msg.sender] by radVal before vat.move.
candidates is indexed by the miner-influenceable keccak256(cdp, now/1 hours) value.
members_ replaces the allowlist consumed by the onlyMember modifier.
give transfers CDP ownership to dst and rebuilds the linked list.
quit migrates the position into dst, which is gated by urnAllowed(dst).
ilk selects the collateral type used for the vat calls performed by bite.
slashScore derives ilk from manager.ilks(maliciousCdp) before penalising.
wad is the amount forwarded to VatLike(vat).flux.
usr is the delegate whose urnCan entry is written by urnAllow.
newOwner replaces _owner in Ownable after the onlyOwner check.
data is the arbitrary calldata executed by emergencyExecute on the chosen target.
data becomes the raw payload of the low-level target.call in emergencyExecute.
target is the arbitrary address called by the auth-protected emergencyExecute.
target receives the call, allowing arbitrary code execution and reentrant state reads.
pool_ becomes the onlyPool address in the LiquidationMachine constructor.
urn = urns[cdp] is cached before the seize calculations in bite.
urn is reused by doBite for the vat.frob calls that move the position.
dtab = mul(rate, dart) is the rad amount pulled from the pool into the contract.
dink is the seized collateral returned by calcDink and passed to doBite.
dink returned by man.bite is split into user, jar and member ink rewards.
usedCushion = mul(cushion[cdp], dart)/art is subtracted from cushion[cdp].
bart = sub(dart, usedCushion) is the residual debt forwarded to doBite.
winner is the single candidate returned when art < minArt.
chosen = uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(cdp, now / 1 hours))) % candidates.length is predictable.
getCushionInfo reuses the same keccak256(now/1 hours) index to pick the small-amount winner.
the onlyMember scan must set member = true or Pool.bite reverts with not-member.
index locates msg.sender inside cdpData[cdp].members for bite accounting.
availBite caps dart against the member's un-bitten share of the pool cushion.
numMembers is produced by getNumMembers and threaded into getCushionInfo/getCdpData.

normalization_plan.reason: The cdp parameter only exists to select the owns[cdp]/cdpCan entry validated by the cdpAllowed guard, so it collapses into that function core.
dtopup is only used to derive dtab and to mint debt inside topup.
dart is consumed entirely by bite for debt wiping and collateral sizing.
radVal is a plain balance amount debited from rad[msg.sender] during withdrawal.
candidates is only ever indexed and filtered inside chooseMember.
members_ is written straight into the members allowlist by setMembers.
dst is the new owner/urn destination consumed by the ownership transfer path.
ilk is only used to select the collateral type for the vat calls driven by bite.
wad is forwarded unmodified to VatLike(vat).flux.
usr is the delegate key written into urnCan by urnAllow.
newOwner is assigned to _owner through the transferOwnership entry point.
data is the raw payload handed to the low-level call in emergencyExecute, an unsafe operation.
target is the arbitrary callee of the low-level call in emergencyExecute, an unsafe operation.
The urn cache is a temporary view of urns[cdp] used only inside the bite seize sequence.
dtab is a scratch rad value computed and consumed inside bite.
dink holds the collateral sized by calcDink and seized by doBite within the bite flow.
usedCushion is a transient ratio deducted from cushion[cdp] inside bite.
bart is the transient residual debt passed from bite to doBite.
winner is the single-element result produced by chooseMember.
chosen is the keccak-derived index that chooseMember uses to pick a candidate.
member is the boolean flag computed by the onlyMember guard that admits the caller into bite.
index is a positional lookup inside cdpData[cdp].members used only by bile accounting.
availBite is the transient cap applied to dart at the start of Pool.bite.
numMembers is the loop counter/aggregate produced by getNumMembers and passed into getCushionInfo.
